newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac appoints new merger head.
newsitem.headline: Westpac appoints new merger head.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Thursday that it had appointed former County Natwest corporate finance director Adrian Palser as the bank's new head of mergers and acquisitions.

David Willis, global head of Westpac corporate finance, said in a statement that Palser had more than 17 years experience in the banking and finance industry. "His appointment is a major addition to our current mergers and acquisitions business and ensures that we are able to offer the full range of investment banking services to our customers," Willis said.
